meta.title: A saved eRFX draft: with lock_vendors_addition_in_event_creation Off, "Save as draft" is not offered
gaps: Verify that the tenant setting lock_vendors_addition_in_event_creation is Off.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the tenant setting lock_vendors_addition_in_event_creation is Off.

steps.note: Open the Events list so the draft can be reached through the buyer flow.
Confirm the events list rendered before navigating to Drafts.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Open the first saved eRFX draft; drafts reopen on their create screen.
Assert that Save as draft is not offered on the saved draft screen.
